title: Gumball To Flow
description: Add gumball to procedural 3D preview. When moving/rotating/scaling, insert correct transform nodes in the flow graph (translate with sliders/vector, rotate, scale), rewire automatically, make incremental space, re-grab updates existing nodes, configurable transform detail granularity.
summary: Fixed gumball vanishing mid-drag: flow multi-select no longer overwrites preview selection during drag (flow-only setSelection canvas command + fromFlow guard on controller setSelection). Gumball stays mounted while gumballDragActive; anchor follows transform output geometry once eval returns. Live slider updates apply synchronously on each onDrag frame (removed rAF). Stable gumball component key preserves drag state across anchor switch.
